blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur—Police arrested a newly identified high-value drug suspect and confiscated approximately one kilogram of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) valued at P6.8 million during a joint buy-bust operation here early Friday morning. Lt. Col. Shellamie Chang, spokesperson for the Police Regional Office 9 (PRO 9), said the operation was conducted at 2:03 a.m. along Bypass Road in Sitio Presa Mayor, Barangay Tumaga. Operatives from the Regional Drug Enforcement Unit, in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) 9 and local police units, arrested the 39-year-old male suspect, whose identity was withheld.
